item.title: The FAIR Leave Act could help almost five million married people access FMLA leave | National Partnership for Women & Families
item.description: A limitation in the Family and Medical Leave Act means that married couples who work for the same employer have to share their allotment of FMLA leave. The FAIR Leave Act would fix this marriage penalty for the nearly 5 million people who are affected.

item.title: Once Again, Trump and Congressional Republicans Want to Undermine 60 Years of Wage and Hour Protections for Women | National Partnership for Women & Families
item.description: For more than 60 years, federal law has evolved to better protect working women's time and pay. But the Trump administration and Congressional Republicans are trying to make it so fewer workers – particularly women workers – are treated like employees and protected under these laws.
